home.heroSubtitleExtended:
Free access to systematic robotics and engineering education for students and mentors.
The project is built on FIRST values and goals to prepare strong teams and future engineers.
home.aboutText: Taǵylym is an open online platform that gives students and mentors from any region of Kazakhstan free access to structured courses in robotics, programming, and engineering. All tracks are built on FIRST values and criteria, not just to teach robot building, but to help teams grow into strong participants, mentors, and future engineers.
home.aboutCallout: Hundreds of schools with robotics do not use it to its full potential due to a lack of content and mentors.
home.problemText: Today, access to quality STEM education and robotics heavily depends on the city, school, and family income: major centers have specialized Lyceums and clubs, while rural schools, even when they have robotics classrooms, often lack content, methodologies, and mentors. As a result, thousands of children interested in technology do not receive systematic training, do not know about FIRST, and lose the chance to build their engineering path.
home.problemCallout: Over 60% of students in Kazakhstan study in rural schools and small towns where access to sustainable STEM programs is limited.
home.trackDesc: Robot Design, FTC Game Strategy, Motor & Servo Control, Sensor Integration, Autonomous & TeleOp Programming (Blocks/Java), CAD Basics, Engineering Notebook, Judging & Inspire/Connect Prep.
home.mod1Desc: Motor and servo control. DcMotor and Servo classes. Autonomous mode, OpMode, TeleOp, sensor reading.
home.mod2Desc: Onshape/Fusion360 basics. Drawing simple parts. Chassis assembly and creating custom parts for 3D printing.
home.mod3Desc: Practical mechanics. Transmission, wheel types (Mecanum/Omni), linear guides, 3D printing in robotics.
home.mod4Desc: How to maintain an Engineering Notebook. Preparation for Judge Interview. Business planning, fundraising, outreach (Connect).

category.coreValuesText: We are a team. We do the work to find solutions. We know our coaches and mentors don't have all the answers; we learn together. We honor the spirit of friendly competition. We share our experiences. We display Gracious Professionalism® and Coopertition® in everything we do.
